items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: I think that was the reason I became a musician, was Louis Armstrong's not fine.

ctx.x: in music? How old you were and what were the circumstances, if you remember?

Well, I think the first jazz recording I heard was Duke Ellington's Mood Indigo, which my mother or father got when it came out, which was around 1930, I guess, so I was about two or three years old, and I remember it from then. But I became interested in jazz mainly through being interested in the popular bands of the late 30s.
